evidence.quote: My colleagues at the Federal Reserve and I believe that accommodative policies will likely be warranted for an extended period.
At some point, however, as economic recovery takes hold, we will need to tighten monetary policy to prevent the emergence of an inflation problem down the road.
We recently indicated that we expect to purchase the full $1.25 trillion of agency-backed MBS announced in March.
Overall, the Federal Reserve has a wide range of tools for tightening monetary policy when the economic outlook requires us to do so.
because banks are reluctant to lend in current economic and financial circumstances, growth in broader measures of money has not picked up by anything remotely like the growth in the base.

parsed.rationale: The speech reaffirms accommodation for an extended period and completion of large MBS purchases, while devoting much attention to exit tools and eventual tightening. Net, it is roughly balanced with a slight dovish tilt from the near-term guidance.
